ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, and UBOs against: Samoa's domestic PEP list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Samoan Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) AML/CFT screening directives. Enhanced due diligence is triggered for PEPs, complex structures, and cross-border wire transfers; all screening must be documented and retained for at least 5 years post-termination of the relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry Online (Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, MCIL – Companies Office)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in English or Samoan (Latin script). Chinese or other non-Latin characters are not accepted in the official registered name; any intended foreign name must be transliterated into Latin script and accompanied by a certified translation into English/Official Samoan.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon final rejection of the name reservation, the applicant must file a written appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 21 days of the rejection notice. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, the applicant may file a further appeal to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 14 days, and thereafter may seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for an International Company under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended). The company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa at the office address of a licensed registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated 5% annual probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection by the Registrar of International Companies or FIU for a standard low-risk offshore manufacturing holding entity. The Registrar retains full legal authority to conduct inspections at any time.

incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation (Form IC-1) together with Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement. The International Company may issue shares with or without par value and may commence business immediately upon incorporation. No escrow account or capital deposit is required by law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers hereby adopt the Memorandum and Articles of Association and subscribe to 100 ordinary shares of no par value issued to the initial subscriber. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company shall be fixed at the address of the registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and the registered agent is approved. RESOLVED that the following persons be and are hereby appointed as directors and officers as listed in the filed consents. RESOLVED that the Company shall engage in the manufacture of ultra-high-definition 4K minimally invasive rigid endoscopes and related equipment, and the directors are authorized to execute all filings, licenses, and permits required for such business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name reservation request through a licensed registered agent or the online international companies portal. Confirm the proposed company name ends with 'Limited', 'Corporation', or 'Incorporated' and is not similar to any existing registered name. Submit notarized consents of each proposed director.
required_dossiers: Notarized consent to act as director of each proposed director
Brief description of intended business activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused or deemed misleading, submit up to two alternate names within five business days, or file a written appeal with the Registrar within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Constitutive Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public and International Companies Registry, MCIL
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English in accordance with the International Companies Act 1987. Have all subscribers execute the documents before a notary public. Include permitted objects, share structure, director appointment rules, and indemnification provisions. Obtain certified notarized copies.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as director of each initial director
Consent to act as secretary or registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficient or incomplete clauses may be cured by executing a supplemental memorandum or amending articles and re-notarizing the corrected pages before re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Statutory Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed and notarized Application for Incorporation (Form IC-1), together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and a statutory declaration of compliance. Pay the prescribed government filing fee of USD 100 by direct transfer or approved payment gateway.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statutory declaration of compliance by the proposed director or agent
Proof of payment of the government filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition, respond in writing within 14 days by providing supplementary information or complying with any amendment order. A fresh statutory declaration may be required where facts have materially changed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar registers the International Company, issues a Certificate of Incorporation, and opens a public file. The company may then adopt the first board resolutions and open bank accounts or commence business activities, subject to any applicable licenses.
required_dossiers: Approved incorporated file containing the Certificate of Incorporation
Certificate of incorporation issuance fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate is lost or destroyed, file a notarized lost-instrument affidavit and pay the prescribed replacement fee for a certified true copy.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Registered Office and Agent Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent within five days of incorporation, and maintain the statutory registers of directors, officers, shareholders, and charges at the registered office in Samoa. Confirm the registered agent's acceptance in writing.
required_dossiers: Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent
Register of Shareholders and Beneficial Ownership statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing is cured by submitting a late notice with the applicable late filing penalty and a letter of explanation; incorrect entries are corrected by filing an amended notice and updating the statutory registers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Health - National Medicines and Medical Devices Regulatory Authority, together with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) - Environmental Assessment and Management Unit
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B2 - Small-scale manufacturing facility requiring a Preliminary Environmental Report; full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) report only where significant discharge or hazardous waste risks are identified
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must comply with the Samoa Water Resources Management Regulations (≤50 mg/L BOD5 and ≤100 mg/L TSS); volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions must not exceed 100 mg/m³; hazardous waste handling must conform to the Waste Management Act 2011 and the Basel Convention transboundary movement requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority; structural load inspection report certified by a licensed engineer and approved by the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure; workplace clearance certificate from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour verifying occupational health and safety compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue, Government of Samoa (official portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws; taxpayer online services and electronic VAGST filing are available through the Ministry's Samoa Taxpayer Online System)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Samoa International Company ('IC'): (1) obtain the certificate of incorporation and International Company status certificate from the Registrar of Companies; (2) if the IC will make any taxable supplies in Samoa, obtain a TIN/VAGST registration by filing the prescribed registration application through the Ministry of Revenue online portal; (3) provide the IC incorporation number, local registered agent details, registered office address, expected annual turnover, and description of business activities; (4) the Ministry of Revenue issues a tax identification number and/or VAGST registration number. An IC transacting exclusively offshore is statutorily exempt from Samoan income tax and VAGST and is not otherwise required to complete annual national income-tax registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or entity-classification election exists in Samoa. The IC's tax-exempt status is conferred non-electively under the International Companies Act 1987. An IC may elect to surrender its international status with the approval of the Registrar, thereby becoming an ordinary Samoa company subject to entity-level income tax and VAGST. VAGST-registered businesses may elect grouping or tax-period arrangements under the Tax Administration Act 2012. Samoa does not currently provide hybrid-mismatch or pass-through elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 annual taxable turnover (mandatory threshold; voluntary registration is permitted for suppliers making lower-value supplies; importers may be required to register when importations exceed the prescribed minimum).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa has not mandated real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, API clearance, or government-issued digital stamping for commercial invoices. A VAGST-registered supplier must issue invoices containing prescribed particulars (supplier name and address, VAGST registration number, invoice date and number, description and quantity, consideration, and VAGST charged). VAGST returns and payments are filed electronically through the Ministry of Revenue's online system, but no per-invoice government pre-clearance is currently enforced.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAGST-registered exporters may zero-rate tangible goods (including Ultra-HD 4K minimally invasive rigid endoscopes and surgical laparoscopy towers) where the goods are physically exported from Samoa and the exporter retains documentary evidence of shipment to the non-resident buyer. Offshore services supplied to a non-resident recipient, where the benefit of the service is consumed entirely outside Samoa, may also be zero-rated. In each case the supply must be made to an offshore recipient and invoiced in the ordinary course; local supplies in Samoa are taxable unless a schedule exemption applies. An International Company operating outside Samoa is outside the VAGST net, but where it incurs Samoan VAGST on inputs, a zero-rated export pathway permits refund via the Ministry of Revenue.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoa Customs export declaration (Customs Export Entry/Exit statement)
Bill of lading or air waybill evidencing export from Samoa to the foreign destination
Inward remittance certificate or SWIFT wire transfer evidence confirming receipt of export proceeds from the overseas buyer
VAGST zero-rated sales invoice (where the exporter is VAGST-registered)
Certificate of origin or any certificate or export permit required for medical device exports
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry of Revenue may require export documentation evidence before allowing or retaining any zero-rating benefit and may review refund claims for up to the statutory document-retention period (generally not less than five years). Incorrect or fraudulent zero-rating claims attract reassessment to the full VAGST shortfall, interest at the prescribed statutory rate, and civil penalties under the Tax Administration Act 2012, including penalties of up to 150% of the tax shortfall. Knowingly providing false or misleading customs or tax documentation may expose officers to criminal fines and imprisonment. Any refund paid is recoverable as tax due, with interest and penalty, if the export is not completed, the prescribed evidence is not produced, or the export consideration is not received within the required period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), established under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984, with exclusive foreign-exchange administration under the Exchange Control Act 1974, the Exchange Control Regulations 1975, and delegated authority to authorized dealers (licensed commercial banks). The CBS operates a managed-float currency regime for the Samoan Tala (WST), which is referenced against a trade-weighted basket of AUD, NZD, USD, EUR, and JPY.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa accepted IMF Article VIII obligations (2011), confirming free convertibility for current-account payments and transfers. Current-account transactions (trade settlement, services, dividends, and branch profits) are remittable through authorized dealers without CBS case-by-case approval, subject to standard supporting-documentation checks. Capital-account transactions (equity injections, shareholder loans, debt repayment other than trade credit) remain subject to CBS licensing or authorized-dealer delegated limits. For the tax-exempt International Company (International Companies Act 1987), dividend and profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are not subject to withholding tax, provided audited financial evidence and a valid tax-exemption certificate are filed with the bank; the bank makes a delegated-authority determination and files an exchange-control declaration with CBS for statistical purposes. WST is not a deliverable hard currency offshore, so clearing and settlement are ultimately executed in USD, AUD, or NZD. The practical convertibility hurdle is not legal prohibition but the bank's AML/KYC evidence requirements and the 2-5 business day CBS reporting window for larger capital movements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Regulations 1975, all export proceeds must be repatriated to Samoa through an authorized dealer within six (6) months of the date of export (or such extended period as CBS may permit). The statutory default is that 100% of foreign-currency export proceeds must be offered for conversion into WST. However, an International Company may obtain CBS approval to maintain a designated Foreign Currency Account (FCA) at a Samoan bank, permitting retention of USD proceeds where the underlying contract, counterparties, and payment flows are entirely non-resident. Practically, the CBS and authorized dealers grant blanket FCA retention for International Companies with a SIFA-registered agent, audited books, and monthly/quarterly exchange-control reporting, provided the proceeds are not used to fund domestic WST expenditure.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Multi-Currency Operational Account (USD, AUD, NZD, WST) with FCA sub-ledger for export proceeds
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (USD, WST) for non-resident International Companies
Operational Foreign Currency Account (USD, AUD, NZD) with trade-finance desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low/Prohibited in substance. Samoa has no digital bank, EMI, or virtual-asset licensing regime, and the CBS does not recognize foreign electronic-money institutions as authorized dealers. Samoan commercial banks will not accept or execute instructions to/from unlicensed EMI wallets (including EEA-licensed EMIs or crypto on/off-ramps) due to correspondent-bank de-risking (APG mutual evaluation scrutiny). The only compliant cross-border rails are SWIFT MT103/MT202 via a Samoan authorized dealer and its correspondent banking relationships (typically BSP's AUD/USD corridor through Australia). An offshore EMI may be used only as a non-banking aggregator for reconciliation, never as a settlement rail, and must be declared to the Samoan bank in the KYC file to avoid account freezing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical presence in practice. For an International Company, all signatories and directors (or the authorized agent with a board resolution) must attend an in-person KYC interview at the bank's Apia branch under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2019 (as amended) and CBS KYC Guidelines. Remote opening is not codified, and while BSP may accept a 'remote close' via a SIFA-licensed registered agent with notarized/consularized passport copies for low-risk corporate clients, this is discretionary and typically requires the registered agent to have an existing banking relationship. Budget for a 3-5 business day physical onboarding visit to Apia for the first signatory and the company secretary/registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company with historical bearer-share features, nominee shareholders, or an offshore jurisdiction of incorporation for ultimate parents.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Beneficial Ownership Register (BOR) certificate under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2022; full BO declaration naming every natural person above 25%; notarized copies of passports of all ultimate beneficial owners; a legal opinion from Samoan counsel confirming no bearer shares outstanding and compliance with SIFA record-keeping; the company's certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing; an organizational chart from the regulated parent entity to the Samoan IC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: US$1 million+ capital injection without a clear audit trail or with unexplained source of wealth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed source-of-wealth statement; audited financial statements of the shareholder or parent for the last two fiscal years; bank reference letter from the remitting institution confirming the remitter's identity and account ownership; currency conversion evidence if the remitter is in CNY/EUR; board resolution approving the share subscription; and a tax settlement/clearance certificate from the shareholder's tax jurisdiction confirming the funds are not proceeds of tax evasion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade counterparties located in high-risk, sanctioned, or grey-listed jurisdictions (e.g., DPRK-adjacent logistics, China export-control overreach, or APG-identified deficiencies).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated sanctions-screening reports for all suppliers, buyers, insurers, and freight forwarders; end-user certificates for the ultra-high-definition rigid endoscope components; full commercial contract suite with proforma invoices and bills of lading; BIS/EU end-use statements if any component has dual-use characteristics; business-vs-beneficial-owner name matching for all SWIFT remitters; a compliance memorandum from a licensed Samoan financial adviser if any jurisdiction risk indicator is triggered.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Letterbox-company substance suspicions: no employees, no physical registered office, minimal economic activity except invoice routing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-office lease agreement with the SIFA-licensed registered agent in Apia; evidence of at least one local company secretary/registered agent with access to books and records; a local compliance officer appointment letter; payroll records for any local personnel (even part-time); the IC's audited income statement and balance sheet demonstrating manufacturing-related gross margin rather than pure invoice-passing; third-party verification of the IC's warehouse/quality-control arrangement with the contract manufacturer (CMC) in the endoscope supply chain.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing sequence: (1) The non-resident shareholder executes a board resolution and share-subscription agreement referencing the International Company registry number and the endoscope-manufacturing business purpose (ISIC 3250); (2) the shareholder remits USD/AUD via SWIFT MT103 from its own bank account to the Samoa IC's dedicated Capital Escrow Account at BSP/NBS/SCB, with the SWIFT field 70 remittance information stating 'Equity injection under International Companies Act 1987 - WS_IC'; the remitter name in field 50 must be the legal entity's exact name as registered, not a nominee or alias; (3) the receiving bank files an Exchange Control Declaration (Capital Import) with the CBS via the delegated-authority portal, attaching the subscription agreement and BO register; (4) CBS approval or deemed approval is typically issued within 2-5 business days for amounts up to the authorized-dealer delegated ceiling (approximately WST 2 million equivalent; higher amounts go to CBS case-by-case); (5) after approval, escrowed funds are released to the operational USD account; (6) the bank issues a Certificate of Capital Import, which serves as the documentary anchor for future dividend repatriation and for any FX hedge application. The IC must not co-mingle trade receipts with the capital injection; separate sub-accounts are mandatory to facilitate CBS audit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Required clearing rails: (a) SWIFT MT103 telecommunication wires for supplier payments (component imports for 4K laparoscopy towers, optics, cables, sterile packaging) up to the authorized-dealer delegated limit, supported by a proforma invoice, purchase order, and contract; (b) Commercial Letters of Credit (SWIFT MT700) issued by BSP/NBS/SCB on an irrevocable, confirmed basis for higher-value shipments, with the IC as applicant and the Chinese/EU/US component manufacturer as beneficiary; documents must include commercial invoice, bill of lading, insurance certificate, and packing list; (c) standby LCs (MT760) for distributor performance guarantees where hospital tenders require it; (d) direct USD wires to EU/US clearing via BSP's correspondent banking corridor (Australia-based), typically 2-5 business days. All outbound disbursements above the delegated ceiling require prior CBS exchange-control approval and must cite the IC reference and the underlying ISIC 3250 purchase order number. Partial prepayments above 30% are disfavored; the bank will require an L/C or third-party escrow to mitigate trade-based money-laundering risk. USD inflows from medical-device buyers may be routed via TT Wire without an LC, but the bank must see the purchase order and the IC's sales invoice (MT103 plus supporting documents retained in file for 7 years).
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore FX spot contracts (USD/WST, AUD/WST, NZD/WST) executed with the authorized dealer for same-day settlement of trade obligations.

Onshore FX forward contracts (maximum tenor 12 months) on USD/WST, AUD/WST, and NZD/WST, permitted against underlying trade documentation (export proceeds or import payables) and limited to 100% of the documented exposure; these are offered by BSP in practice, with two-way pricing against the CBS official rate.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing WST, permissible only with prior CBS notification and proof of genuine economic exposure (hedging, not speculation); market depth is extremely thin and execution is rarely available, so most ICs rely on multi-currency accounts to achieve natural hedging.

Cross-currency swaps with a licensed commercial bank for IC debt obligations, subject to CBS capital-account approval; in practice, Samoa's onshore market does not support such instruments, and the IC should instead denominate its intercompany loan in USD to avoid WST conversion risk.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Fee for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority / Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the annual fee for each month or part of a month that payment is overdue, capped at 50% of the annual fee; continued non-payment beyond 6 months may trigger administrative strike-off and separate restoration fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Declaration of Compliance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation, or on the date specified by the registered agent in the standard compliance calendar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default filing fee escalating to USD 100 if filed late; repeated failure to file within 6 months may result in strike-off, loss of legal status, and inability to enforce contracts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Confirmation and Register Review
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent in Samoa holding custody of corporate registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: to be completed on or before the annual return filing date or 31 March, whichever is earlier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Agent is required to cease business transactions and notify the Registrar of non-compliance; continued default may subject the company to restoration proceedings and loss of tax-exempt status.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandatory for a standard International Company incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987; an audit becomes compulsory only if the company is licensed as a bank, insurance company, or trust/fiduciary service provider, or if the Registrar of International Companies issues a specific direction requiring audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) for any company electing to prepare financial statements; otherwise the International Companies Act does not mandate preparation or public filing of annual financial statements, and internal management accounting may be maintained without statutory format.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must notify its registered agent within 14 days of any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership; the agent must update the UBO register and issue an annual confirmation to the company. The confirmation is retained in the registered agent's file and at the registered office in Samoa. No public UBO filing is required, but the register must be produced to the Registrar or competent authority upon lawful request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - USD 1,500 per annum for licensed registered agent and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 7,500 per engagement for a voluntary audit or a triggered audit of a compact manufacturing entity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for the Samoa International Company (IC); 27% for a domestic taxable company under the Income Tax Act 2015
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The IC enjoys a statutory tax-exempt zone under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended) and is exempt from income tax, corporate tax, withholding taxes on exempt income, capital gains tax, and stamp duties; exemption is lost only if the IC conducts trade in Samoa or fails ESR substance requirements

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Exempt IC: Annual Return under section 105 of the International Companies Act 1987 filed with the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce Industry and Labour (MCIL) through the Samoa Companies Registry online portal. Domestic taxable company: Form R1 Company Income Tax Return filed through Samoa Inland Revenue e-Services.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Exempt IC: within 90 days after each anniversary of incorporation; taxable company R1: within 6 months after the fiscal year-end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Registered name and IC number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full company name, unique IC registration number, and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the name exactly as registered; no English translation or trade name is sufficient for this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address in Samoa where the IC is located, not a post office box.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed Samoa international company service provider address is acceptable if the IC operates remotely.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the Samoa-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must sign and confirm that invoices for the laparoscopy tower business do not violate the IC's no-domestic-trade condition.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, and shareholding interests of directors and any ultimate beneficial owner.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owners must be disclosed to the registered agent; bearer shares are prohibited and must be dematerialised before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, issued and paid-up capital, assets, liabilities, revenue and expenditure summary for the 12-month period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State worldwide gross revenue from the manufacture/sale of 4K laparoscopy towers; this is informational for ESR risk classification, not taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tick the applicable relevant activity (manufacturing/distribution/headquarters/IP/dormant) and confirm board meetings, employees, and physical assets in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident parent must attach a substance calculation showing where procurement, quality control, and profit-allocating functions are performed; no false 'core income-generating activity in Samoa' claims may be made.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Exempt IC: late filing fee of WST 200 per month or portion, deregistration and cancellation of the registered agent; false substance declaration attracts a fine up to WST 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 7 years. Domestic taxable R1: late filing penalty equal to 10% of the tax due, plus 2% monthly surcharge, plus 200% shortfall penalty for deliberate evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for distributions made by an exempt International Company; 15% statutory dividend withholding tax for a resident domestic company paying a dividend to a non-resident shareholder
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke any Samoa double tax agreement (DTA), the non-resident shareholder must (1) obtain a Samoa tax residence certificate/TRC confirming residence in the treaty state, (2) submit a DTA relief claim and beneficial ownership declaration to Samoa Inland Revenue before or at the time of remittance, and (3) retain the payer's certificate of WHT paid; no relief is granted where the IC was already exempt because there is no Samoan tax against which a foreign tax credit can be applied.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory: royalties paid to non-residents are subject to 15% final withholding tax and interest to non-residents is subject to 15% final withholding tax when sourced in Samoa; for an exempt IC, royalty, interest or distribution payments to offshore related parties are generally not Samoa-sourced and therefore carry 0% WHT. Treaty rates, where applicable, commonly reduce royalties to 10% and interest to 10% or 0%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,000,000 of aggregate controlled transactions (or 30% of gross revenue if lower) requires a contemporaneous Local File; a Master File is expected when the worldwide group revenue exceeds WST 100,000,000. Exempt ICs file the economic substance annex instead of an income-tax TP schedule but should keep the same transfer pricing documentation available for substance review.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's ESR under the International Companies (Economic Substance) (Amendment) Act 2018 requires every IC carrying on a relevant activity (including distribution and service centres or IP holding) to demonstrate adequate board management, employees, and physical expenditure in Samoa proportionate to the activity. If the IC merely invoices sales of 4K laparoscopy towers and all manufacturing is performed by an offshore affiliate, a pure distribution activity exists and the substance threshold must be met in Samoa by a local office or by a compliant outsourced service provider; otherwise the IC will be treated as non-compliant and subject to exchange of information reporting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / False Economic Substance Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Executing an off-shore sham where all board decisions, sales negotiations, and inventory management for the laparoscopy tower trade occur in Hong Kong or China, while the Samoan Annual Return states that substance is present in Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment at 27% plus a 200% penalty on tax shortfall; administrative penalty up to WST 1,000,000 for false declarations; deregistration of the IC; referral to the criminal courts for tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false returns are jointly and severally liable, may be disqualified for 10 years, and may be imprisoned for up to 7 years; the court may also issue a travel ban and asset freeze pending prosecution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC solely as a conduit to re-invoice surgical endoscope sales, strip profits, and claim IC tax exemption while the beneficial owner has no physical presence, no staff, no contracts executed under Samoan law, and no commercial function in Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off from the International Companies Register, forfeiture of the exempt status, refund of any distributions illegally made, and a fine of up to WST 100,000 under the International Companies Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The court will pierce the corporate veil; directors and shadow shareholders receive a civil restitution order covering the diverted profits and are personally liable for all liquidation costs and unpaid supplier invoices.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Exporting 4K rigid endoscopes and laparoscopy towers without the required Samoan medical-device manufacturing/exporter license; processing payments through IC bank accounts without ultimate beneficial ownership verification; issuing invoices that mis-describe the product to avoid US FDA/EU MDR declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: FIU administrative fine up to WST 500,000, criminal fine up to WST 1,000,000, forfeiture of the transaction funds, cancellation of the registered agent, and reporting to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit as a suspicious transaction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorize unlicensed exports or sanctions evasion risk up to 10 years imprisonment, personal asset forfeiture, travel bans, and being named in an AML enforcement action by Samoa's FIU.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling endoscope towers to a related Hong Kong distributor below arm's length CUP or paying a management fee to an offshore affiliate that has no employees and no risk-bearing function, thereby shifting all residual profit out of the economic substance review.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transfer pricing adjustment increasing taxable income, additional tax of 200% of the shortfall, interest at 8% per annum, and a WST 50,000 penalty for failure to file the contemporaneous Local File.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the TP manipulation is fraudulent, directors can be made personally liable for the adjusted tax, barred from managing companies, and prohibited from leaving Samoa until the tax debt is settled.
